definitions.explanation: Thick, muddy waste material, especially the sediment that accumulates in sewage treatment plants, rivers, or industrial processes. Also used for contaminated mud from disasters.

examples.japanese: {汚泥|おでい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{処理|しょり}する→処理する：25531_shorisuru⟧。
⟦{下水|げすい}→下水：00069_gesui⟧⟦{処理場|しょりじょう}→処理場：09653_shorijou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{大量|たいりょう}→大量：03112_tairyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{汚泥|おでい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発生|はっせい}する→発生する：25529_hasseisuru⟧。
examples.english: A large amount of sludge is produced at the sewage treatment plant.

examples.japanese: ⟦{洪水|こうずい}→洪水：05065_kouzui⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧、⟦{道路|どうろ}→道路：01481_douro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{堆積|たいせき}→堆積：29631_taiseki⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧{汚泥|おでい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{撤去|てっきょ}→撤去：14729_tekkyo⟧⟦{作業|さぎょう}→作業：02775_sagyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いている→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: After the flood, work to remove the sludge deposited on the roads continues.

notes:
Composed of {汚|お} (dirty, polluted) and {泥|でい} (mud). A technical term commonly found in environmental, civil engineering, and disaster-related contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {汚泥|おでい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{処理|しょり}→処理：03251_shori⟧ (sludge treatment)
- {汚泥|おでい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{除去|じょきょ}する→除去する：22368_jokyosuru⟧ (to remove sludge)
- {汚泥|おでい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{撤去|てっきょ}→撤去：14729_tekkyo⟧ (sludge removal)
- ⟦{下水|げすい}→下水：00069_gesui⟧{汚泥|おでい} (sewage sludge)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {汚泥|おでい}: sludge (technical, environmental)
- ⟦{泥|どろ}→泥：03492_doro⟧: mud (everyday)
- ヘドロ: slimy sediment, ooze (colloquial, often foul-smelling)
